scenarios.name: Dependency unavailable during startup
scenarios.injection: DB Connection Refused / Engine Unavailable
scenarios.expected: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, status='unhealthy', truthful reporting

scenarios.name: Dependency disappears after startup
scenarios.injection: Active socket drop / server closed connection
scenarios.expected: /api/system/health transitions to DEGRADED without crash

scenarios.name: Dependency reconnects
scenarios.injection: Restoration of DB engine connection pool
scenarios.expected: Health status transitions back to OPERATIONAL/READY seamlessly

scenarios.name: Camera stream disconnect
scenarios.injection: TCP RST / packet loss > 20%
scenarios.expected: Camera status transitions ACTIVE -> INACTIVE/DEGRADED

scenarios.name: Camera stream reconnect
scenarios.injection: Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff
scenarios.expected: Camera status restored to ACTIVE without orphaned workers

scenarios.name: Malformed binary frame
scenarios.injection: Invalid header bytes / corrupted memory block
scenarios.expected: Graceful rejection, marked invalid format, no pipeline panic

scenarios.name: Unsupported codec injection
scenarios.injection: AV1 / VP9 payload into H.264/H.265 ingestion pipeline
scenarios.expected: Quarantine into Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) with CodecUnsupported error

scenarios.name: Corrupted frame bytes
scenarios.injection: Zero-byte payload, non-ASCII binary characters
scenarios.expected: Clean normalization rejection, confidence <= 0.65, is_valid=False

scenarios.name: OCR unreadable text failure
scenarios.injection: Heavy blur / unreadable alphanumeric noise ('??--XX')
scenarios.expected: Low confidence return, invalid format flag, no false positive alert

scenarios.name: AI model unavailable (CUDA OOM)
scenarios.injection: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory (simulated VRAM allocation failure)
scenarios.expected: Worker buffers events, publishes to error topic, no lost case state

scenarios.name: Kafka consumer restart & offset replay
scenarios.injection: Mid-batch consumer SIGKILL
scenarios.expected: Consumer restarts and resumes from committed offset without message loss

scenarios.name: Duplicate event deduplication
scenarios.injection: Duplicate sighting within 30-second temporal sliding window
scenarios.expected: Collapsed into existing alert; remarks appended; single alert preserved

scenarios.name: Event replay idempotency
scenarios.injection: Replaying identical historical sighting event
scenarios.expected: Alert count strictly invariant (1 == 1); no duplicate incidents created

scenarios.name: Redis restart & cache failover
scenarios.injection: Redis daemon disconnect during high-speed cache read/write
scenarios.expected: Graceful fallback to in-memory dictionary; transparent cache recovery

scenarios.name: PostgreSQL restart & pool recovery
scenarios.injection: engine.dispose() simulating DB server hard reboot
scenarios.expected: Next transaction cleanly re-establishes TCP connection pool

scenarios.name: MinIO object storage offline
scenarios.injection: S3 Endpoint connection refused (port 9000)
scenarios.expected: Storage health reports UNAVAILABLE; evidence seal fails closed

scenarios.name: OIDC Keycloak IdP unreachable
scenarios.injection: JWKS discovery connection failure / 504 Gateway Timeout
scenarios.expected: Token verification raises HTTP 401; anonymous access strictly denied

scenarios.name: Government API timeout (VAHAN/NIC)
scenarios.injection: NIC Gateway timed out after 5000ms
scenarios.expected: 3 exponential retries, reports LOOKUP_FAILED, measured latency recorded

scenarios.name: Government API HTTP 401 Unauthorized
scenarios.injection: Invalid mTLS Certificate / IP not in GSWAN whitelist
scenarios.expected: Returns LOOKUP_FAILED; credentials not leaked; no pipeline stall

scenarios.name: Government API HTTP 500 Internal Error
scenarios.injection: HTTP 500 Database Deadlock
scenarios.expected: Handled with retries, status='LOOKUP_FAILED', error logged
